item.title: Several soldiers feared dead in Yobe road crash
item.description: By Maryam Abdul-aziz Usman Several soldiers are feared dead, while others sustained injuries in a road accident involving a military vehicle at Garin Malam Adamu, near Buni Yadi, headquarters of Gujba Local Government Area of Yobe State. The accident reportedly occurred on Friday, November 20, while the soldiers were travelling from Buni Yadi to Damaturu, the state capital. The victims were reportedly evacuated to the Yobe State University Teaching Hospital, Damaturu, for medical attention. Although the exact casualty figure remains unknown, preliminary accounts have linked the accident to the poor condition of the affected section of the road. As of the time of filing this report, military authorities had yet to officially confirm the incident or disclose the number of casualties. The post Several soldiers feared dead in Yobe road crash appeared first on Vanguard News .

item.title: Motherwell 1-2 Rangers: What McInnes said
item.description: [SNS] Rangers manager Derek McInnes: "Three points is what we came here for. We'll take the good from it, we'll take the three points and it was a brilliant moment when you score late on. Those sort of late winners are systematic with teams that you think can be successful. "Obviously, you would much rather have the game far more comfortable in terms of the result. I thought we defended really well. My two centre-halves were magnificent throughout. We didn't dominate but we were very close to it. The performance was really strong. We should've been far more comfortable. "Taking the game away from the opposition on chances created, that should've been the case. "But, when the game is still in the balance and you're putting a bit of pressure on, it's good to know that you've got a bit of evidence there that you can score late winners. I think there's a belief in the team that there's goals, certainly a belief from myself and the staff that we feel there's a goal coming."

item.title: 3 Falcons defenders hit with 4 fines from Week 10 loss to Chiefs
item.description: Photo by Perry Knotts/Getty Images | Getty Images The Falcons racked up nine penalties in last week’s lackluster loss to the Kansas City Chiefs, but they were all procedural — there weren’t any flags for actions that typically lead to fines. But that didn’t stop the NFL from issuing four fines total to three different defensive players stemming from last Sunday’s action. Defensive lineman Brandon Dorlus was the lucky guy who got hit with two fines, each for $7,114. One was for unsportsmanlike conduct/taunting, and one was for a late hit on a quarterback. DeMarcco Hellams, who slid into the starting spot opened up by the Falcons’ decision to trade Jessie Bates III to the Jaguars before the NFL’s deadline, owes the NFL $6,509 for unnecessary roughness/a hit on a defenseless player, and linebacker Harold Perkins was also fined $5,203 for unnecessary roughness/use of the helmet. The NFL splits the fine money it collects from players between the NFL Foundation to support the health, safety and wellness of athletes at all levels of football and the Professional Athletes Foundation to support NFL Legends in need. Falcons fines and player discipline 2026 Jake Matthews, $11,941: Unnecessary roughness, face mask, Week 2 Cameron Thomas, $8,333: Unnecessary roughness, use of the helmet, Week 3 Chris Blair, $5,972: Unnecessary roughness, blindside block, Week 6 Drake London, $12,537: Unnecessary roughness, striking/kicking/kneeing, Week 8 Drake London, $23,882: Unnecessary roughness, use of the helmet, Week 9 Brandon Dorlus, $7,114: Unsportsmanlike conduct, taunting, Week 10 Brandon Dorlus, $7,114: Late hit on a QB, Week 10 DeMarcco Hellams, $6,509: Unnecessary roughness, hit on a defenseless player, Week 10 Harold Perkins, $5,203: Unnecessary roughness, use of the helmet, Week 10

item.title: 76ers’ Tyrese Maxey receives ‘happy’ praise from analyst
item.description: Bill Streicher-Imagn Images 76ers’ Tyrese Maxey receives ‘happy’ praise from analyst appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . The Philadelphia 76ers have plenty of reasons to appreciate what Tyrese Maxey brings to the court. The guard’s energy, pace and ability to create offense have made him an important part of the team’s identity. Moreover, his playing style continues to earn attention around the NBA. In a recent post, SiriusXM NBA shared a clip of analyst David Aldridge explaining why Tyrese Maxey is one of his favorite players to watch. Speaking with BGeltzNBA and Ben Lyons, Aldridge praised the 76ers star for the joy he brings to the game. “He plays with joy, he’s happy,” Aldridge said. He also noted that Maxey understands he earns a lot of money to play a kid’s game and appreciates that opportunity. Furthermore, Aldridge can clearly see the work Maxey has put in over the years. “I just love watching him play basketball,” he added. "I just love watching him play basketball" @davidaldridgedc tells @BGeltzNBA and @iamBenLyons why Tyrese Maxey is one of his favorite players to watch in the NBA. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) Listen to the full show: https://t.co/LilkergPt6 pic.twitter.com/L0bKdpXwiQ — SiriusXM NBA Radio (@SiriusXMNBA) November 21, 2026 Aldridge’s praise reflects the positive impression Maxey has made beyond Philadelphia . His game features constant movement and attacking pressure. For instance, he pushes the ball in transition, drives toward the rim and creates opportunities for teammates. As a result, his energy makes him entertaining to watch, even without the ball. Meanwhile, Maxey continues to play a central role in the 76ers’ plans . His scoring ability and willingness to take responsibility have established him as one of the team’s leading players. Additionally, his continued development makes him a threat that opposing defenses must account for throughout a game. Ultimately, Aldridge’s comments were not tied to a particular highlight or statistical milestone. Instead, they reflected a broader appreciation for Maxey’s approach to basketball. For Philadelphia, having a young star who impacts games while making basketball enjoyable to watch is a valuable combination. item.title: Australia hold on for narrow win against Wales
item.description: Australia secured a record win against Wales on their previous visit to Cardiff in 2024 [Huw Evans Picture Agency] Nations Championship Wales (7) 26 Tries: Lake 2, Murray, Elias Cons: Costelow 3 Australia (12) 29 Tries: Tupou, Paenga-Amosa, Jorgensen, Ikitau Cons: Lonergan 2, Gordon Pens: Gordon Wales could not emulate their famous victory against New Zealand as Australia claimed the Nations Championship spoils in Cardiff. The Wallabies ended a four-match losing run thanks to tries from hooker Brandon Paenga-Amosa, prop Taniela Tupou, wing Max Jorgensen and centre Len Ikitau, while fly-half Carter Gordon kicked a late penalty. Wales captain Dewi Lake scored two tries, while full-back Blair Murray also crossed following a superb assist by wing Louis Rees-Zammit. Replacement hooker Ryan Elias grabbed a late try but Australia held on for victory as Wales paid the price for not capitalising on attacking chances. Wales finished fifth in the northern hemisphere section and will play Japan at the Allianz Stadium in Twickenham on Saturday (13:10 GMT). Australia finished third in the southern hemisphere table and play Ireland on Friday (20:10 GMT). Fans flock back to the Principality Stadium After all the hysteria and celebrations to mark a first victory against the All Blacks in 73 years, the attention turned towards whether Wales could back it up against Australia. There was a vibrancy on the streets of Cardiff before the game not seen for a while, which reflected in the crowd. After crowds of 52,425 against Japan and 55,152 against New Zealand, the 66,307 attendance against Australia was the highest of the autumn. The All Blacks win proved instrumental in a surge of tickets sold for a 20:10 GMT kick-off, the latest for a Wales rugby home game at the Principality Stadium. Head coach Steve Tandy made four changes to revert to the side that beat Japan with flanker James Botham the most notable absentee following his player-of-the-match against New Zealand. Botham was expecting the birth of his first child this week but Tandy stated his omission was for rugby reasons with Cardiff colleague Alex Mann replacing him. Fit-again number eight Aaron Wainwright replaced Taine Basham, while lock Ben Carter and wing Josh Adams returned for Adam Beard and Gabriel Hamer-Webb. Australia had freshened things up with five forward changes as flanker Carlo Tizzano, lock Tom Hooper and the front-row trio of Isaac Kailea, Paenga-Amosa and Tupou came in. Australia open scoring after Llewellyn yellow card Wales lost centre Max Llewellyn inside two minutes to a yellow card for a high tackle on Wallabies full-back Tom Wright. Wallabies had plenty of early possession against 14 players but the home defence comfortably dealt with the attack. Mann was caught with some friendly fire by a finger in the eye from team-mate Carter but continued despite appearing to have vision issues. Rees-Zammit almost squeezed into the corner but just failed to ground the ball under pressure from Gord

item.title: Eagles Urged to Trade Up for Best WR Prospect in 25 Years
item.description: Ohio State wide receiver Jeremiah Smith. Getty The Philadelphia Eagles grabbed a wide receiver in the 1st round of the 2026 NFL Draft, landing USC’s Makai Lemon at No. 23 overall. That doesn’t mean he has to be their future at the position. That player will be in the 2027 NFL Draft: Ohio State wide receiver Jeremiah Smith. He’s on track to become the first wide receiver taken with the No. 1 overall pick since the New York Jets selected USC’s Keyshawn Johnson with the top pick in the 1996 NFL Draft. Bleacher Report’s Brent Sobleski put the Eagles at the top of his list of teams that should do whatever it takes to trade up for Smith — a deal that could easily package 1st-round picks with Lemon to make it happen. The Eagles are 2-7 and have lost 7 straight games. If the draft were tomorrow, they would have the No. 5 overall pick. “Calvin Johnson, AJ Green, Julio Jones and Ja’Marr Chase are the best wide receiver prospects over the last 25 years,” Sobleski wrote on Saturday. “None of them were the No. 1 overall pick in their respective draft classes. Ohio State’s Jeremiah Smith is on par with all four as a prospect and possibly even better. NFL teams should be falling over themselves to try to acquire his services … Smith can completely change the complexion of the Eagles’ roster, especially on offense. What the team lost when it traded AJ Brown can be reinserted with a younger, more explosive version. Thus, a trio of Jeremiah Smith, DeVonta Smith and Lemon will be extremely difficult to defend, with each placed in specific roles to maximize their skill sets.” “This is a once-in-a-lifetime WR prospect right here,” Touchdown Tube wrote on its official Instagram account. Jeremiah Smith: Definition of Generational Prospect Smith, 6-foot-4 and 223 pounds, is currently the projected No. 1 overall pick in the latest mock drafts from both Bleacher Report and ESPN . From B/R: “Smith is a proven, game-changing wide receiver with a special blend of size, speed and strength. The 6’4″, 225-pound target plays through contact, using physical route-running to shed handsy defenders. With excellent acceleration and long speed, Smith glides past corners and threatens the defense vertically. The Ohio State receiver is an NFL WR1 from Day 1 and should be peppered with targets early and often.” Three Teams in Running for No. 1 Overall Pick Three AFC teams are 1-8 headed into Week 11 and all neck-and-neck for the No. 1 overall pick — the Miami Dolphins, Los Angeles Chargers and Tennessee Titans. ESPN’s Jordan Reid has Smith going to the Titans at No. 1 in his latest mock draft. “Smith is the best player in this draft, and as the first wide receiver to go No. 1 since 1996 (Keyshawn Johnson), he would allow the Titans to continue to build around quarterback Cam Ward, the No. 1 pick of the 2025 draft,” Reid wrote on November 18. “How special is Smith? He has drawn comparisons to some of the best wideouts of the past quarter century — including Calvin Johnson, Larry Fitzgeral

item.title: Customs seize contraband worth N3.52bn in Ogun
item.description: .recover cannabis, codeine syrup, others By James Ogunnaike, Abeokuta The Nigeria Customs Service (NCS), Ogun I Area Command, has intercepted and seized contraband goods with a total Duty Paid Value (DPV) of ₦3.52 billion as part of intensified efforts to curb smuggling, protect public health and safeguard the nation’s economy. The seizures, which include 6,037 wraps of cannabis, 20,500 bottles of codeine-containing cough syrup, more than 1.45 million tablets and capsules of various brands, foreign parboiled rice, petroleum products and vehicles, were inspected and paraded by the Comptroller-General of Customs during a visit to the Command. According to a statement issued on Saturday, by the Public Relations Officer of Ogun I Area Command, Assistant Superintendent of Customs Paul Gimba, the total value of the seized items with available valuations stood at **₦3,517,838,700. The statement said the seizures reflected the Command’s sustained efforts to combat smuggling and prevent the circulation of prohibited and potentially harmful products in the country. A breakdown of the intercepted items showed that cannabis accounted for 6,037 wraps, valued at ₦1.268 billion, while 20,500 bottles of cough syrup containing codeine had a Duty Paid Value of ₦147.6 million. The Command also intercepted 828,920 tablets of different brands valued at ₦795.76 million and 627,320 capsules worth ₦376.39 million. Other pharmaceutical products seized included 2,850 ampoules of Enox 4000 injection, valued at ₦17.1 million, and 95 prostate pills worth ₦570,000. The seizures further included 5,173 bags of 50kg foreign parboiled rice, valued at ₦455.22 million, alongside 1,067 used tyres worth ₦52.82 million. In the petroleum products category, Customs intercepted 1,037 kegs of 25 litres of Premium Motor Spirit (PMS), valued at ₦34.22 million, and 1,008 kegs of 25 litres of Automotive Gas Oil (AGO), worth ₦44.35 million. Other seized items comprised 21 packages of walkie-talkies, 185 packages of sanitary pads and diapers valued at ₦18.13 million, 125 live cartridges and two trucks with a combined valuation of ₦144 million. The Command also recorded seizures of several used vehicles, including a 2024 Toyota RAV4 and Toyota Highlander valued at a combined ₦50 million; two Lexus vehicles worth ₦25 million; a 2000 Toyota Hilux valued at ₦11 million; a 2013 Toyota RAV4 worth ₦17 million; and a Toyota Sienna valued at ₦14.7 million. Other vehicles intercepted were a 2010 Toyota Venza valued at ₦14.6 million, an Opel worth ₦7.3 million, a Mazda valued at ₦7.1 million and a 2012 Range Rover Sport worth ₦17.2 million. The Customs Service said the interceptions underscored the Command’s determination to enforce relevant Customs laws, prevent the importation and circulation of prohibited goods and protect Nigeria’s economic interests. item.title: Avalanche Linked to Sidney Crosby, but Have a Major Problem
item.description: CHICAGO, ILLINOIS - OCTOBER 13: Sidney Crosby #87 of the Pittsburgh Penguins looks on against the Chicago Blackhawks during the first period at United Center on October 13, 2026 in Chicago, Illinois. (Photo by Michael Reaves/Getty Images) Getty It had been an open secret. But now it’s official. It’s coming down to the Montreal Canadiens and Colorado Avalanche in the Sidney Crosby sweepstakes. The door is now officially open in Pittsburgh. Kyle Dubas sent a very clear message Wednesday: the Penguins are ready to make moves. With a 7-11-2 record and the team sitting near the bottom of the Eastern Conference standings, the general manager has announced a fire sale. He wants trades focused on the future, bringing in young players who can contribute to the next version of the Penguins. And in the middle of all this, there’s obviously Sidney Crosby. The captain is set to become an unrestricted free agent on July 1. If Pittsburgh decides to move him before then, Crosby himself would have to agree to a trade to a contender. Dubas acknowledged that he had spoken with his veteran players about the organization’s situation and what could happen over the coming weeks. He also emphasized his tremendous respect for Crosby and said he would respect whatever decision the captain makes. In a nutshell, Pittsburgh will trade him to whichever team he wants. In an article published in the Toronto Sun, Bruce Garrioch identified the two potential destinations that could battle for the legendary forward: Colorado and Montreal. Sidney Crosby to Avalanche? Colorado Faces Major Trade Hurdle On the Avalanche’s side, Nathan MacKinnon is Crosby’s best friend. The idea of bringing the two superstars together in the same uniform would obviously be incredibly appealing. MacKinnon would certainly love to have his close friend alongside him as they try to win another Stanley Cup. But Colorado has a major problem: its available assets. The Avalanche have already sacrificed a significant number of draft picks and young players to build their current roster. They don’t own their first-round picks in 2027 or 2028. Their prospect pool is also extremely limited, and when you look at the organization’s top 10 young players, it’s easy to understand why Pittsburgh would never accept an offer from Colorado. The first name is goaltender Ilya Nabokov, a 23-year-old playing for the Colorado Eagles in the AHL. Selected 38th overall in 2024, he possesses excellent mobility and impressive athleticism. He enjoyed three strong seasons in the KHL before moving to North America. He’s an interesting prospect, but Pittsburgh doesn’t need another young goaltender, especially with Sergei Murashov already viewed as part of the Penguins’ future. The second is Egor Shilov, an 18-year-old center selected 43rd overall in 2026. He scored 32 goals and recorded 82 points with the Victoriaville Tigres in the Quebec Maritimes Junior Hockey League. item.title: Four downs from DeWitt football's state semifinal loss to Zeeland West
item.description: CALEDONIA — Here is reaction from the DeWitt football team falling in a Division 3 state semifinal to Zeeland West 42-26 in a matchup of the last two state champions in D3. Player of the game Niko Mongkhoun, Zeeland West: The senior the tone for the Dux with an 80-yard touchdown run on the opening play of the game. Zeeland West never looked back from there and never trailed while advancing to the state final. Moungkhoun ran for 185 yards on 11 carries and recovered a fumble. Key moment DeWitt trailed 22-13 at half and was set to receive the kick to open the second half. Zeeland West recovered a squib kick to open the third quarter. Less than two minutes later the Dux had capped the drive with a touchdown and added a 2-point conversion to take a 30-13 lead. What it means DeWitt closes its season with an 10-3 record and reached the state semifinals for a third straight year. This is the second time in three seasons the Panthers have had their season end with a loss to Zeeland West in the state semifinal. DeWitt dropped to 0-3 against the Dux in the postseason. Zeeland West reaches the Division 3 state final for the second time in three years with the win and will face Harper Woods at Ford Field on Saturday, Nov. 28. Quotable "Momentum swings are big in any game but especially games of this magnitude. That (squib kick) wasn't a great start for us by any means (in the second half) but we made a lot of mistakes today and part of it is because of them and part of it is us not being as disciplined as we needed to be against a team like that on both sides of the ball and with special teams. If you're going to beat a team that doesn't make many mistakes you can't make them yourselves and we made some today for sure." DeWitt coach Rob Zimmerman Contact Brian Calloway at bcalloway@lsj.com. Follow him on X @brian_calloway. This article originally appeared on Lansing State Journal: Four downs from DeWitt football's state semifinal loss to Zeeland West

item.title: Chiefs Fans Slam $3 Billion Stadium Design as Clark Hunt Considers Controversial New Fee
item.description: Chiefs Fans Slam New Stadium Getty Kansas City Chiefs fans aren’t happy with the team’s plans for a new $3 billion stadium in Kansas. Many have criticized the dome design, while others are concerned they could soon have to pay more for season tickets. The Chiefs plan to leave Arrowhead Stadium and move into the new 70,000-seat venue in 2031. However, after seeing images of the proposed stadium, some furious fans questioned why the team is replacing Arrowhead’s open-air setting with a dome. Adding to their frustration, Chiefs chairman Clark Hunt confirmed the team is considering personal seat licenses (PSLs), which would require season ticket holders to pay an additional fee just to purchase their seats. Chiefs Fans Criticize New Stadium Design and Proposed Dome View this post on Instagram The planned stadium has already drawn criticism from fans who believe the design looks too similar to other modern NFL venues. Much of the frustration centers on the decision to build a dome rather than another outdoor stadium. “Sweet… looks like every other stadium built in the last ten years. I’m sure a sellout stadium will be so much better than Arrowhead,” one fan wrote on social media. Another supporter commented, “Not a single soul likes this boring, recycled dome stadium.” Others questioned whether the new venue would offer the same experience as Arrowhead, which has been the Chiefs’ home since 1972. “We do not care. Chiefs fans do not want a dome!” one X user posted. Another added, “Just like every other ugly domed stadium. No one is coming to ‘experience’ this as they do at Arrowhead. Generic trash with zero tradition or history.” Some fans also expressed frustration about not having a say in the stadium plans. “Literally nobody asked for this. The people who bought tickets for 50 years and paid for this stadium had no say in this. 90% of us hate it,” one supporter wrote. The Chiefs have not announced changes to the proposed design in response to the criticism. Clark Hunt Confirms Chiefs Are Considering Additional Season Ticket Fees To replace one of the greatest stadiums in the sport with a high tech shopping mall is an American tragedy Congrats, you turned Arrowhead into another lifeless dome 👍 Stadiums should be UNIQUE and football was meant to be played OUTSIDE Corporate Greed is ruining football at… https://t.co/dcZ0ZLpPcZ pic.twitter.com/VfudGG8FrW — Sebastian Fearon DPT, CSCS, OCS (@TheDegenDoc) November 19, 2026 Beyond the stadium’s appearance, fans are questioning how much it will cost to attend games at the new facility. Hunt confirmed that the Chiefs are exploring personal seat licenses, which would require fans to purchase a license for their seats separately from their season tickets. The team’s agreement with Kansas allows the organization to implement the fees. Several NFL teams, including the Buffalo Bills, Tennessee Titans and Las Vegas Raiders, have used similar arrangements. item.title: Weekend Warm-up: Did Bayern Munich do the right thing in signing Jamal Musiala and Alphonso Davies to massive deals?
item.description: (Photo by Marcel Engelbrecht - firo sportphoto/Getty Images) | Getty Images There is an uncomfortable question hanging over Bayern Munich’s recent contract strategy — did the club make the right investments in Jamal Musiala and Alphonso Davies, or did it allow the fear of losing two exceptional talents to dictate financial decisions that could eventually become difficult to justify? Both players received lucrative, long-term extensions in February 2025. At the time, Bayern Munich vie wed them as essential building blocks for the future. Musiala was arguably the most exciting young attacking talent in German football, while Davies remained one of Eur ope’s most sought-after left-backs. Losing either player, particularly on a free transfer, would have been a significant sporting and financial setback. At the time that each signed, it was reported that neither had a serious suito r. But there was another consideration that could not be ignored — neither player had an entirely clean injury history. Bayern Munich was committing enormous money to two footballers whose availability had already become a recurring concern. That concern has become considerably harder to dismiss since the contracts were signed. The numbers from Transfermarkt provide some perspective on why Bayern Munich’s decision deserves scrutiny. Its seasonal injury-history summaries include both days unavailable and matches missed, althou gh the records also include some non-injury absences, such as illness, quarantine, and fitness-related issues. item.description: Texas is playing Arkansas in the school’s final home game of the 2026 college football season on Saturday. Texas is 8-2 and is trying to improve to 9-2 overall, while keeping its spot in the College Football Playoff. The program has won four straight after last Saturday’s last-second 22-21 win over LSU. MORE: 7 most unlikely College Football Playoff teams in CFP era Before this Saturday’s game kicked off, Texas quarterback Arch Manning posed for a picture with his parents for Senior Day. While nothing is official, it could signal that Manning will declare for the 2027 NFL Draft after the season ends. Here’s the picture, courtesy of KXAN’s Noah Gross : Senior Day / Longhorn Farewell for Arch Manning & family #HookEm pic.twitter.com/PTc7k9ADXy — Noah Gross (@noah_gross27) November 21, 2026 Manning’s 2026 campaign has been up and down, with 2,198 yards, 19 touchdowns, and 10 interceptions. Texas quarterback Arch Manning (16) celebrates after a college football game at Neyland Stadium in Knoxville, Tenn. on Sept. 26, 2026. item.title: Wake Forest Takes Apart Georgia Tech, 50-29
item.description: | Source: Lastwordonsports.com - Tony Siracusa, CFB Managing Editor It wasn’t pretty or artistic. While it was a blowout, it certainly was not the same type of route Wake Forest has been delivering of late; it was good enough to get the job done. Wake Forest takes apart Georgia Tech, 50-29, and gets one game closer to a spot in the ACC championship game. Wake Forest Takes Apart Georgia Tech The weather was dark, gloomy, and sometimes wet during the game. The mood on the field matched. The game was chippy from the outset. Before the game, Wake players were headed to gather in their end zone. It just so happened to be at the same time Georgia Tech was coming out of its tunnel. Words were exchanged, but nothing else. The Usual Early Start And then Wake scored early and often, and some of the aesthetic beauty of the game went by the wayside. By the end, penalty flags became the common sight throughout much of the second half. Wake ended the game with 12 penalties for 111 yards. The conference office can count on hearing from Wake head coach Jake Dickert on a few of them. Wake scored on its first drive of the game, which has become the norm lately. Ty Clark III pushed his way up the middle from four yards out for the touchdown, capping a 12-play, 78-yard drive. The drive featured everything that has been Gio Lopez this season. The drive was a mix of completed passes to three different receivers, some of his own runs (both by design and scrambling), and managing the offense. Georgia Tech, knowing it was going to have to empty the bag of tricks to stay with Wake, went to the flea flicker on its next series. Dalen Penson had picked up 24 yards to the Wake 32 after making the catch, but he was hit by Deuce Blades and fumbled. It was Blades who also recovered the ball. The ensuing drive was another mix of run and pass plays, with Clark picking up 16 of the 68 total yards on the drive. It took 10 plays before Lopez ran a quarterback keeper to the front left corner of the end zone from two yards out. Wake ran a two-point conversion, as it does at least once a game, and the lead was up to 15-0. Staying on the Ground The Deacs run game was again decisive. Out of the 607 yards of total offense, 261 were on the ground. Deuce Lawrence led the running backs with 105 yards and a touchdown on 13 carries. Clark finished the game with 98 yards and two touchdowns on 18 carries. The lead grew in the second quarter. Lopez threw a pass out in the flat to Jack Foley. The defender dove at the wideout and missed. That cleared a path for Foley to weave his way through traffic for a 66-yard touchdown. The 50-second scoring drive put the score at 22-0 early in the second quarter. Justice Haynes fumbled away GA Tech’s next possession at the Yellowjackets’ 47-yard line. Aiden Hall recovered the ball, and the Deacs were on the offensive attack again. Lopez threw deep to Carlos Hernandez, who made a spinning catch in the air at the Georgia Tech eight-yard line. item.title: Eagles make 3 injury roster moves before Steelers clash
item.description: Bill Streicher-Imagn Images Eagles make 3 injury roster moves before Steelers clash appeared first on ClutchPoints . Add ClutchPoints as a Preferred Source by clicking here . As the Philadelphia Eagles prepare for their Week 11 home matchup against the Pittsburgh Steelers, they face a challenging 2-7 record amid a turbulent season. On Friday, the team announced in their injury report that wide receiver DeVonta Smith would return after missing three games due to a hamstring injury. NFL Network’s Ian Rapoport confirmed, “WR DeVonta Smith is officially back.” However, linebacker Zack Baun and wide receiver Dontayvion Wicks were ruled out due to back and ankle/foot injuries, respectively. Before the game, the Eagles’ front office made several significant roster changes that affected the timeline for two injured players and welcomed back an important offensive asset. On Saturday, NFL Network insider Mike Garafolo reported the team had placed both Baun and Wicks on injured reserve, stating, “The #Eagles placed LB Zack Baun and WR Dontayvion Wicks on IR. RB Will Shipley was activated from IR.” This decision to place Baun and Wicks on IR means they will be sidelined for at least four games, indicating their injuries require extended recovery periods. This will put additional pressure on Philadelphia’s coaching staff to rely on their remaining depth in those positions. On a positive note, activating Shipley, who had been out since Week 5 with a foot injury and was listed as questionable entering the weekend, provides immediate support to a backfield eager to enhance its running game alongside Saquon Barkley. Watch sports LIVE with fuboTV (free trial) With starting quarterback Jalen Hurts out indefinitely and the offense struggling for consistency, Shipley’s return to the active roster, combined with Smith’s prior production of 26 catches for 310 yards before his injury, is crucial for revitalizing the offense against Pittsburgh. The absence of Baun and Wicks will test the Eagles’ resilience as they strive to regain momentum during a challenging 2026 season. item.title: Kentucky vs. Missouri game discussion and pregame reading
item.description: The final SEC game for the Kentucky Wildcats is here as Will Stein and his squad are in Columbia for a date with the Missouri Tigers . Game time is set for 7:30 PM ET on SEC Network. Sitting at 7-3, Kentucky is ranked as the No. 16 team in the country and just a few spots off from making the College Football Playoff. A win over the Tigers could help propel the Cats closer to making the field, but the question is: Can the Cats actually knock off the Tigers? Missouri has lost three of its last four and is coming off a similar two-game slide as Kentucky. Sitting at 6-4, the Tigers are going to be hoping to pick up a major win and spoil the postseason dreams once and for all for UK. How can Kentucky avoid the upset? First and foremost, the offense needs to reappear. After scoring 20 points in two games, the offense disappeared when the team needed it most. Going to have to score to win this game tonight. Secondly, the Wildcats have to stop the run. We saw Aaron Philo run all over the Cats last week, and while Austin Simmons isn’t known for his legs, Jamal Roberts is one of the top running backs in the league, and Ahmad Hardy is getting healthier every week. Going to have to slow him down to make the Mizzou offense one-dimensional. Should be a fun one tonight in CoMo. Let’s hope the Cats can pick up the win. item.title: In first start, Keisean Henderson rallies No. 24 UH to walk-off win over West Virginia
item.description: Keisean Henderson, the nation's No. 1 quarterback recruit last year, stepped in for an injured Conner Weigman and guided UH back from a 10-point deficit for a win at West Virginia. (William Wotring/Associated Press) MORGANTOWN, W.Va. - Jonathan Dimas made a 23-yard field goal as time expired as No. 20 Houston rallied from a 10-point deficit in the second half to beat West Virginia 34-31 in quarterback Keisean Henderson's first career start. Henderson, a true freshman who was the nation's No. 1 recruit in 2026 , was forced to start in place of Conner Weigman. Weigman was ruled out about an hour before kickoff with a shoulder injury. Team officials originally thought Weigman would be able to play but he "did not feel right" during pregame warmups, according to the TNT broadcast. On the third play of the game, Henderson found Amare Thomas wide-open near midfield for a 68-yard catch-and-run touchdown. Makhi Hughes rushed for 158 yards and touchdown runs of 21, 2 and 3 yards Henderson was 18-of-28 for 258 yards and a touchdown. Before Saturday, Henderson had been limited to 17 snaps this season. His most extensive work was in a 77-6 win against Southern in Week 2. Henderson marched the Cougars down the field for a 13-play, 86-yard drive that was capped by Hughes' third touchdown, a 3-yard run to tie the game at 31-31. item.title: France secure Nations Championship final with Springboks
item.description: France have won back-to-back Six Nations titles [Getty Images] Nations Championship France (14) 45 Tries: Guillard, Mauvaka, Gourgues 2, Gailleton, Duguid, Bielle-Biarrey Cons: Gourgues 5 Argentina (10) 17 Tries: Piccardo, Matera Cons: Albornoz 2 Pen: Albornoz France dispatched Argentina in Paris to book their spot against South Africa in the Nations Championship final at Allianz Stadium next Sunday. Knowing pre-game a bonus-point victory at Stade de France would be enough to edge England out of the top spot in the northern hemisphere standings, Les Bleus had to work hard to secure the points required. Lock Mickael Guillard powered over for the opening score, but Justo Piccardo responded for the visitors before Tomas Albornoz nudged them ahead with a penalty. Argentina have not been at their best this November, suffering a heavy defeat by Ireland before narrowly beating Italy. However, as is often the case with the Pumas, the longer they spend together, the more they tend to improve as a campaign progresses. Felipe Contepomi's side brought the first-half physicality needed to trouble France, who turned to their maul late in the first half to score through Peato Mauvaka and reclaim the lead. Fly-half Matthieu Jalibert, who missed the win over the world champions through injury, then expertly sent Kalvin Gourgues through a gap to score. The pivotal moment came when Argentina prop Mayco Vivas was shown a 20-minute red card for making direct head contact at a ruck, with France capitalising on the extra man to score their bonus-point try through Emilien Gailleton. Hooker Julian Montoya then joined Vivas in the sin-bin after receiving a yellow card and France made their numerical advantage count once again as Tyler Duguid and Gourgues crossed. Pablo Matera intercepted Louis Bielle-Biarrey's pass to improve the scoreline but Bielle-Biarrey made amends to dot down a brilliant kick into space by Antoine Dupont. It will now be rematch of last Friday's epic game in Paris, which France narrowly won 21-19 against the world champions. South Africa booked their spot in the final by picking up a losing bonus point against Ireland. Scotland will play Argentina on Sunday at Allianz Stadium in the seventh/eight-place play-off. Can win over All Blacks finally break England's boom-bust cycle? Rugby Union Weekly: England eclipse the All Blacks after record-breaking win Ireland remind themselves that the best are beatable Line-ups France: Attissogbe; Grandidier-Nkanang, Gourgues, Moefana, Bielle-Biarrey; Jalibert, Dupont (capt); Jelonch, Ollivon, Capilla; Guillard, Verhaeghe; Falatea, Mauvaka, Gros Replacements: Lamothe, Poirot, Montagne, Duguid, Woki, Alldritt, Lucu, Gailleton Argentina: Prisciantelli; Delguy, Cinti, Chocobares, Mendy; Albornoz, Benitez Cruz; Isa, Scelzo, Gonzalez; Lavanini, Petti; Moreno, Montoya (capt), Wenger Replacements: Bosch, Vivas, Sclavi, Elias, Rubiolo, Matera, Moyano, Isgro Sin bin: Vivas (61 mins), Montoya (67 mins) Match officials Referee

item.title: Brunicke’s Goal Proves Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Is Ready To Fly
item.description: Charles LeClaire-Imagn Images Harrison Brunicke just proved he belongs at the next level with a single play. The Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins trailed the Lehigh Valley Phantoms 2-0 before a turnaround on Friday. Brunicke scored the go-ahead goal with a solo rush that left everyone in the arena staring. The Penguins won the game 4-2, and Brunicke was the main reason why. A Goal That Defines a Season In his previous four games, Brunicke had accumulated four goals prior to Friday’s contest. He corralled the puck in his own zone and skated around three Phantoms players. With 4:15 remaining in the third period, he shot the puck top shelf to secure a 3-2 advantage for his team. Yahoo Sports noted that he has now scored five goals in his last five games. The Penguins also got two goals from Bill Zonnon, who tied the game early in the third period. Late in the final frame, Atley Calvert secured the victory by scoring an empty-net goal. The final score of 4-2 looks close, but Brunicke’s goal was the difference maker. Why the NHL Needs to Watch Heading into their upcoming matchup, the Wilkes-Barre/Scranton Penguins hold a record of 9-6-3. They face the Rochester Americans on Saturday night. Before being designated the second star of the game, Brunicke recorded a goal and an assist. Zonnon took the first star spot for his two goals. The team is showing they can win even when they fall behind early. Brunicke has scored a point every single time he has played against the Phantoms. The statistic indicates he performs best against that team. If he keeps this up, a call to the NHL club will not be far away. Brunicke’s performance on Friday night was the kind of play that changes a roster spot.

item.title: Jets Add 4,800-Yard Wide Receiver Before Chargers Game
item.description: Sterling Shepard is getting a significant opportunity with the Jets. Getty The New York Jets are turning to Sterling Shepard against the Los Angeles Chargers. “The Jets are elevating WR Sterling Shepard from the practice squad, per source,” The Athletic’s Zack Rosenblatt reported on X on November 21. The Jets are elevating WR Sterling Shepard from the practice squad, per source. — Zack Rosenblatt (@ZackBlatt) November 21, 2026 Shepard, 33, is a former second-round pick, taken 40th overall by the New York Giants in the 2016 draft. Shepard’s NFL journey has included stints with the Tampa Bay Buccaneers and, briefly, the Houston Texans. He has 444 receptions for 4,803 yards and 25 touchdowns in his career. Jets Make Final Move on Sterling Shepard With WR Room Banged Up Shepard has appeared in two games for the Jets this season, tallying one reception for 3 yards on two targets. His latest opportunity comes amid the news that rookie first-round pick and fellow receiver Omar Cooper is out due to a ankle and hip injuries. Another receiver, Isaiah Williams, is also out, as he deals with a ribs issue. Geno Smith has no game designation for Sunday pic.twitter.com/PgUIDy6yNe — New York Jets (@nyjets) November 20, 2026 This also means that Shepard is out of elevations with the Jets. If they want him active for another game, they must sign him to the 53-man roster. Otherwise, the Jets would have to find another option if need be. That can be tricky at this stage of the season, a lost one at that. Shepard is a veteran with experience in multiple offensive systems, which further strengthens his case for a roster spot. That is, if a spot opens up. It remains to be seen how long Cooper is out this time after he missed a chunk of time at the start of the season due to an ankle injury. The Jets have navigated injury issues all season, including with starters Garrett Wilson and Adonai Mitchell, while backup Arian Smith is already out for the season and on IR. For the Jets, injuries only add to the insult of their 2-8 (so far) season. item.title: Rising profile of Tems, Asake and Nigerian artists’ Grammy journey
item.description: By Ayo Onikoyi The voices are getting louder everyday that Asake and Tems are the new King and Queen of Afrobeats respectively. And the Recording Academy confirmed it on November 16, 2026 when it announced the nominees for 2027 Grammy awards. Asake appears just to be coming to his own with two nominations while Tems shatfers the roof with four Grammy nominations in one year. Tems has emerged as Nigeria’s most successful representative in the latest nomination cycle, earning four nominations and further establishing herself as one of the most versatile Nigerian musicians on the international stage. Her recognition in the R&B categories is particularly noteworthy. It demonstrates that her appeal extends beyond the African music market and that her songwriting and vocal abilities are attracting recognition in mainstream American music. The nominations also build on an impressive Grammy history. Tems won her first Grammy in 2023 for her contribution to Future’s “Wait For U”, featuring Drake, which won Best Melodic Rap Performance. She subsequently won Best African Music Performance in 2025 for her reimagining of “Love Me JeJe”. She has also received recognition for her contribution to Beyoncé’s Renaissance, Wizkid’s “Essence” and Rihanna’s “Lift Me Up”, from the Black Panther: Wakanda Forever soundtrack. With two Grammy victories already to her credit, Tems is approaching the 2027 ceremony with an opportunity to increase her collection and further strengthen Nigeria’s presence in international R&B. Asake on the other hand has not won any Grammy – yet. But he appears to be knocking on the door. The “Lonely at the Top” hitmaker has now received four Grammy Award nominations as of November 2026. His nominations are all in the Best African Music Performance category. His flirting with the Recording Academy started in 2024 with his hit “Amapiano” with Olamide, followed by “MMS” with Wizkid in 2025. Once again, he has dragged Wizkid onto the Grammy ballot with their collaboration “Jogodo” and his own solo hit “Gratitude” in 2027 Six Nigerian stars earn 2027 Grammy nominations as Afrobeats expands global reach, with the country securing representation in Best African Music Performance, Best Global Music Album, Best Global Music Performance and Best R&B Song. Joining Tems and Asake on the list are: Burna Boy with one nomination for Dia Dia with Shakira for Best Global Music Performance; Wizkid has one nomination too, for his collaboration with Asake on “Jogodo”; Ayra Starr has two nominations for Best Global Music Album with her hit “Starrgirl” and Best African Music Performance on the “Aye Kan (Are You Coming Back?)” collaboration with Angélique Kidjo and Davido with one nomination as his album “Oriadé” earned a place in the Best Global Music Album category, where it will compete against projects by Tems, Ayra Starr, Anitta and Angélique Kidjo. item.title: Why the Alamodome's real NFL legacy endures in cities other than San Antonio
item.description: The Alamodome is seen with the San Antonio skyline on Thursday, Nov. 12, 2026, from the city's East Side neighborhood. (Andrew J. Whitaker/San Antonio Express-News) Through the bus window, a young NBA player saw something that caught his attention. And as the Golden State Warriors rolled past downtown San Antonio on their way to Frost Bank Center, he asked a longtime member of the team's traveling party an obvious question. "Why is there a football stadium here?" the player wondered. That was two Fridays ago, and it was far from the first time in its 33-year history that the Alamodome's mere existence has served as a source of consternation. On that Warriors bus, for instance, not even those who'd been coming here for decades were sure they understood the building's intended purpose. Had they stayed through the weekend and secured a local newspaper, they might have learned a thing or two. Last Sunday, a front-page story by Express-News reporter Madison Iszler provided an in-depth look at the dome's uncertain future, which won't include another significant overhaul until at least 2035, when demolition might be one of the options on the table. The Alamodome never became the permanent home of an NFL franchise, despite the unrealistic dreams of the officials and voters who approved its construction. It eventually became obsolete, not only by the standards of the world's richest sports league, but also by those of the College Football Playoff and men's basketball Final Fours now spurning it to set up shop elsewhere. Let it not be said, however, that the Alamodome lacks a real NFL legacy. In its own way, it reshaped the geography of professional football. And across this country there are more than a couple of billionaires who owe the odd-looking structure on Montana Street a debt of gratitude, not to mention a chunk of their wealth. After all, nobody loved the Alamodome more than the owners who used it as a threat. Look around the NFL today. More than 12% of its franchises play in palaces funded at least in part by public money that was approved amid rumblings that San Antonio might be willing and able to steal those teams away. The Arizona Cardinals play in State Farm Stadium, which was built with the help of $455 million provided by Maricopa County voters in 2001 . The New Orleans Saints play in the Caesars Superdome, which was renovated after 2005's Hurricane Katrina with the help of a $41 million bond package . The Minnesota Vikings play in U.S. Bank Stadium, which was built with a combined $500 million in state and city funds approved by the Minnesota legislature and Minneapolis city government in 2012. And the Las Vegas Raiders play in Allegiant Stadium, built after the Nevada legislature approved a plan in 2016 to use $750 million in public money. In each of those cities, there had been media reports that the teams were considering a move to San Antonio, where a 64,000-seat dome was sitting empty. Some of the flirting was overt. item.description: …tasks police on arrest, prosecution of culprits By James Ogunnaike, Abeokuta Ogun State Governor, Dapo Abiodun has condemned the attack on Nigeria’s football legend and Ogun State Sports Ambassador, Chief Segun Odegbami, calling on the police to ensure that those responsible are apprehended and brought to justice. The Governor expressed deep concern over the incident, describing the attack on the former Super Eagles captain as unfortunate, unacceptable and a threat to the safety of citizens. Abiodun, however, thanked God that the assailants were unable to silence Chief Odegbami, noting that it was a matter of relief that the celebrated sports icon survived the attack. He said Odegbami, fondly known as ‘Mathematical’, remains an outstanding Nigerian whose contributions to the development of sports, particularly football, have earned him national and international recognition. The governor noted that as Ogun State’s Sports Ambassador, Odegbami occupies a special place in the state’s sports development agenda, adding that his experience, influence and enduring commitment to the promotion of sports remain invaluable. Abiodun urged the security agencies, particularly the police, to conduct a thorough investigation into the incident, track down the perpetrators and ensure that they face the full weight of the law. He stressed that no individual or group should take the law into their hands, warning that acts of violence and criminal intimidation would not be tolerated in Ogun State. The governor also wished Chief Odegbami continued strength and good health, assuring him of the state government’s concern and support. He reiterated his administration’s commitment to protecting lives and property and ensuring that Ogun State remains a peaceful and secure environment for residents and visitors. Meanwhile, the State Commissioner of Police, Bode Ojajuni, has assured the football legend that the perpetrators of his attack would be identified and brought to justice. Ojajuni, who gave the assurance, when Odegbami, following an attack on him, at his residence in Abeokuta, noted that visit was aimed at expressing the sympathy of the Ogun State Police Command over the incident and reassuring the former Nigerian international of the police commitment to protecting lives and property across the state. During the visit, Ojajuni reportedly conveyed his concern over the incident and wished Odegbami continued recovery and while assuring him that the command was treating the matter with the seriousness it deserved. The police commissioner disclosed that he had directed an immediate and comprehensive investigation into the incident to establish the circumstances surrounding the attack and identify those responsible. He also assured the former football star that the Command would deploy all necessary investigative resources to ensure that the perpetrators were apprehended and made to face the full weight of the law. item.title: Review: Godzilla Minus Zero joins the list of truly stellar sequels
item.description: It's a rare thing for a film sequel to match or even surpass its predecessor; The Godfather Part II and Terminator 2: Judgement Day are the best known examples on a pretty short list. Go ahead and add Godzilla Minus Zero to that list. Director Takashi Yamazaki's sequel to his critically acclaimed Godzilla Minus One (2023) is everything one could want in a Godzilla movie: human pathos, great special effects, and, ultimately, two giant kaiju duking it out over who gets to destroy Japan (and eventually the world) the most. (Spoilers for the first film below. Spoilers for Minus Zero but no major reveals until after the gallery. We'll give you a heads-up when we get there.) As I wrote previously , Yamazaki wanted to return to Godzilla’s filmic roots with Minus One , setting the events in postwar Japan and tapping into the monster’s symbolic representation of the Japanese perspective on the 1940s nuclear holocaust—while also incorporating all-too-human themes of guilt and redemption. That first film focused on kamikaze pilot Kōichi Shikishima (Ryunosuke Kamiki), who struggled with survivor’s guilt after he failed to take action when Godzilla attacked the Japanese base on Odo Island in 1945. item.title: ‘I Struggled To Come Out, Lost My Sister, Other Relatives,’ Bayelsa Boat Accident Survivor
item.description: A survivor of Friday’s boat accident in the Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of Bayelsa State has recounted how she struggled to escape from the capsized vessel, saying she lost several members of her family and neighbours in the tragedy. The woman, whose identity was not immediately disclosed, said her elder sister, her sister’s daughter-in-law and two children belonging to her relatives and neighbours were among those who died in the accident. Recounting the incident, she said the boat suddenly capsized, trapping passengers beneath it. “The boat just fell and pressed all of us. My elder sister’s son’s wife was lost. My elder sister was lost. Her son was also lost. One of my neighbours who followed us also lost her son. My neighbour herself was lost,” she said. ﻿ The survivor said she was the only person among those close to her who made it out alive, adding that she struggled to escape after the boat overturned. “It’s only me that is safe. When I came out, somebody held me. I was drinking water. I was not able to come out. I struggled before I came out. Where we were standing, the boat broke from above and pressed us down,” she said. Asked by the Bayelsa governor, Douye Diri, whether the bodies of her missing relatives and neighbours had been recovered, she replied in the negative. Her account comes as the death toll from the accident has risen to 23, while 24 survivors are receiving treatment in hospitals. The accident occurred near Oweikorogha Community in the Ukubie area of Southern Ijaw when a boat conveying mourners from Ayama Community to Ukubie for a burial ceremony capsized at about 11 a.m. on Friday. ﻿ The Bayelsa State Police Command confirmed the incident, saying preliminary findings indicated that the boat developed a mechanical fault while navigating the waterways. However, a survivor had also alleged that the wooden passenger vessel, popularly known as a ‘love boat’, was overloaded with passengers and their belongings, raising concerns about possible breaches of waterway safety regulations. President Bola Tinubu has expressed condolences to the families of the victims and directed relevant federal disaster response agencies to support rescue and recovery operations. In a statement posted on his X account, Tinubu described the incident as tragic and said those who died did not deserve to lose their lives in such circumstances. “Those who lost their lives in the tragedy did not deserve to die that way. I have directed all relevant Federal Disaster Response agencies to work together to ensure a successful recovery and rescue operation,” he said. The President also directed that Saturday’s presidential campaign rally in Ibadan, Oyo State, be held without much fanfare in honour of the victims. Meanwhile, Governor Diri has visited the scene of the accident and is expected to initiate an investigation into the circumstances surrounding the tragedy. item.title: Can Enzo Maresca Win The Premier League In His First Season At Man City?
item.description: Six league titles. Ten years. A stand at the Etihad with his name on it. Good luck following that. Enzo Maresca has to, after Manchester City unveiled him as manager back in June 2026. Maresca at least knows his way around the training ground. Back in 2020-2021, he ran the Elite Development Squad and won Premier League 2 with them. He returned in 2022 to work under Guardiola as an assistant, and that season ended with the treble. So this is spell number three, and he’s tied down until 2029. Expectations at City don’t reset just because the man in the dugout has changed. City’s title odds have become some of the most debated in premier league online betting markets because bookmakers must weigh a campaign shaped as much by events off the pitch as on it. A Flying Start, Then A Bump The opening weeks went better than almost anyone expected. Maresca became the first manager in Premier League history to win his first seven games in charge of a new club. The football looked familiar too. City kept the ball and wore teams down, which is no surprise from a coach who learned so much from Guardiola. His Leicester and Chelsea sides played the same way. City spent big to help him. Their summer outlay of around £460 million was a record for any club, and £125 million of it went on Enzo Fernández from Chelsea, a fee that matched the Premier League transfer record. Phil Foden signed a four-year extension. Rodri, one of the faces of the Guardiola years, left for Barcelona. Maresca has won quickly before. He lifted the Championship title with Leicester in 2023-24. A year later at Chelsea, he won the Conference League and the Club World Cup and still finished fourth in the league. Seven straight wins at the start of a season guarantee nothing, of course. Plenty of fast starters have slid down the Premier League table once the winter fixtures arrive. City soon lost three league games in a row, one of them a 1-0 home defeat to Brighton, who had never won away at City before. Then there are Arsenal. Mikel Arteta, another former Guardiola assistant, ended their 22-year wait for the title in 2025-26, helped along by a Premier League record for goals from corners. Manchester City’s Italian manager Enzo Maresca gestures on the touchline during the English Premier League football match between Manchester City and Sunderland at the Etihad Stadium in Manchester, north west England, on September 20, 2026. (Photo by PETER POWELL / AFP) The Fight Off the Pitch The bigger problem might be off the pitch entirely. Early in the 2026-27 season, an independent commission found City guilty of more than 100 breaches of Premier League financial rules. It ruled that the club used “sham” contracts with commercial partners to inflate revenues and cut costs by more than £900 million between 2009 and 2018. City deny any wrongdoing and have appealed. If the verdict stands, they face a heavy sanction, and a big points deduction is one of the options on the table. So Maresca could get everythi

item.title: Bayelsa tragedy boat had no manifest, passengers didn’t wear life jacket – Diri
item.description: By Samuel Oyadongha, Yenagoa A visibly sad Governor of Bayelsa State, Senator Douye Diri, has revealed that the boat involved in the Friday fatal accident in Southern Ijaw Local Government Area had no manifest, and the passengers did wear life jackets. Consequently, Governor Diri vowed that all negligent persons involved will face trial. The governor gave the directive on Saturday after visiting the scene of the accident at the Oweikorogha axis of the river. Also, he visited survivors at the Government House Specialist Hospital in Yenagoa. He directed the Commissioner of Police, the State Director of the Department of State Services (DSS), and the Ministry of Marine and Blue Economy to commence investigation into the cause of the tragedy and submit a report in no distant time. Accompanied by Deputy Governor Dr. Peter Akpe, Deputy Speaker of the House of Assembly Michael Ogbere, and other top government officials, Diri in a statement by his Chief Press Secretary, Daniel Alabrah, condoled with bereaved families and affected communities. “On behalf of the state government, I extend our condolences to the families that have lost their loved ones and the communities that were affected. “I hear there were more victims from Ukubie community where the boat was headed, but several other communities were also affected. So our heartfelt and sincere condolences go to the communities, to the families, and the rest of the state,” he said. The governor described the incident as unfortunate and avoidable if every tier of government had done its job. “I believe that this should not have occurred if every department of government at the federal, state and local government diligently did their job. That is why I am going to institute a probe to ascertain what happened,” he said. Directing the Commissioner for Marine and Blue Economy, the Commissioner of Police and the DSS State Director to investigate, he said: “The Honourable Commissioner, within your ministry, there must be an investigation into this incident. “The Commissioner of Police and the State Director of DSS, I want a report; an investigative report on what happened. All those who have played one role or the other, the law must surely catch up with all of them.” Diri expressed shock that the boat had no manifest and did not board passengers from the designated point at the jetty in Ayama community. No safety measures He also lamented that none of the passengers wore safety vests, despite the availability of life jackets provided by the Federal Ministry of Marine and Blue Economy and the state government. “I cannot imagine a boat like that had no manifest and did not board passengers at the designated point. Today, we have this tragedy on our hands. “So, CP and DSS, you have work to do. I want that report in no distant date from now, so that people will know that there is a government in place here,” he said. item.title: Pain of losing loved ones never goes away – RMD
item.description: By Ayo Onikoyi Veteran actor Richard Mofe-Damijo, popularly known as RMD, has opened up about the emotional challenges of losing loved ones, describing grief as one of the hardest experiences he has had to deal with. The 65-year-old actor made this known during an appearance on At His Right Hand, a podcast hosted by Olive Emodi. Looking back at his personal experiences, RMD disclosed that losing his wife and mother remains a deeply painful part of his life. “Loss of dear people in my life is the hardest thing I have had to deal with. I have lost a wife, I have lost a mother. Loss is very difficult to deal with. The pain never goes away. “What happens is that the pain transitions, morphs into different things,” he said. Beyond grief, the actor also reflected on legacy and the responsibility of giving back, describing his current phase of life as one dedicated to pouring into others. “I am 65, and I am saying it’s your turn. One can always play an advisory role in nation building because you never stop building. I am in the legacy stage of my life. Just as people poured into my life, I think I need to pour into a lot of people’s lives,” he said. Speaking further about talent, the fashionable role interpreter maintained that natural abilities cannot remain suppressed indefinitely, insisting that talent will eventually find an outlet. “It’s a question of time. The stammerer will pronounce his or her father’s name. Same thing with talent. You can’t keep it down even if you try. Somehow, it will find its voice,” he said. item.title: Alcaraz to face Zverev for ATP Finals title
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz rallied past Ben Shelton on Saturday to book his spot in the ATP Finals title match, where he will meet world number one Alexander Zverev as he bids to lift the trophy for the first time. The world number three showed signs of vulnerability but fought through to beat the American 3-6, 6-3, 7-6 (7/1). He will play Zverev in Sunday’s decider, after the two-time Finals champion beat Daniil Medvedev 7-6 (7/0), 6-4 in the other last-four match-up. Alcaraz lost to Italian Jannik Sinner in the season-ender’s showpiece match last year and will aim to go one better this time around in Turin. He has been dealing with a left-thigh injury since Wednesday but, playing with his leg heavily strapped, he extended his winning streak to 13 matches, a run that includes title-winning campaigns in Vienna and Paris. However, it was a hard-fought victory as the Spaniard struggled to play with his usual freedom before pulling through in just over two hours. “I was a little bit frustrated at the beginning because I didn’t start the match the way that I wanted to, to be honest,” said the seven-time Grand Slam winner. “But I’m just happy that I came back in the second set… and ended up playing good tennis.” Having dropped only 15 games across his three round-robin matches without once losing his own serve, Alcaraz was broken in his very first service game against Shelton. The 23-year-old quickly fell behind 3-0 and was unable to claw his way back into the set. In the second frame, Alcaraz upped his level, gaining the upper hand by breaking to lead 5-3 before levelling at one set all. The deciding set remained tight, with neither player facing a break point, forcing the match into a tie-break. Shelton faltered with two unforced errors allowing the Spaniard to pull ahead 5-1, a deficit from which the American could not recover. “I think the third set was even closer. I think he raised the level a little bit from the second set, myself as well,” said Alcaraz. “Great points, great games, and just happy to play great tennis in the tie-breaker… I’m excited for tomorrow.” Earlier in the month, Alcaraz beat Shelton in the Paris Masters final to win the title for the first time — a measure of revenge on the American who had ended his US Open title defence in September. Alcaraz, who missed a chunk of the season with a wrist issue, will nonetheless be able to end his year on a high if he can next beat the man who took his French Open title during his injury-enforced absence. In claiming that title in Paris, as well as the US Open crown, Zverev catapulted himself above Alcaraz and Sinner in the rankings to world No. 1. In a repeat of the 2021 Finals title match, which the 29-year-old German also won, Zverev saw off Russian Medvedev in straight sets. A tightly-contested first frame rattled to a tie-break, which the two-time major winner raced through as Medvedev crumbled, failing to win a point. item.title: Tinubu doing fantastic job on sports infrastructure, says Infantino
item.description: FIFA President Gianni Infantino has commended President Bola Tinubu’s administration for its investment in sports infrastructure, describing its efforts as a “fantastic job” and an indication of Nigeria’s commitment to the future of its young population. Infantino gave the commendation on Saturday while addressing the 48th Ordinary General Assembly of the Confederation of African Football (CAF) in Abuja. The FIFA president urged members of the Nigerian delegation to convey his regards to Tinubu, while acknowledging the contributions of the President and other Nigerian leaders to sports development. “On behalf of President Tinubu, please send him our warmest regards. He is doing together with all of you. Fantastic job here in Nigeria, showing that you are a country projected into the future,” Infantino said. He particularly praised investments in sports facilities, noting that they reflected confidence in the potential of young Nigerians. “We were discussing this yesterday as well, also with the Chairman of the National Sports Commission, my brother Shehu. The investments done in sports facilities infrastructure show that you believe in your youth, in the young girls and the young boys of Nigeria,” he said. “Thank you for that. Congratulations for that,” he added. Infantino also thanked Nigeria for hosting him and his delegation, which included FIFA Secretary-General Mattias Grafström, describing the visit as an opportunity to reconnect with the continent. “Thanks for welcoming me and our delegation with the Secretary-General and the others here at home in Africa, in Abuja. Thank you for your support. It means the world to me,” he said. His remarks followed an inspection of sports infrastructure projects in Nigeria on Friday, including the remodelled Warri City Stadium and the Hussey College mini-stadium and sports complex in Delta State. He also visited the ongoing FIFA Forward Technical Centre project at the Moshood Abiola National Stadium in Abuja, describing the facility as an investment in the future of Nigerian football. “This is a collaboration between Nigerian football and FIFA for the future of the girls and the boys of Nigeria,” he said. During his visit to the Warri City Stadium, Infantino stressed the importance of developing grassroots sports facilities to ensure that football remained accessible to people across communities. “That’s what football is about. It’s for everyone, everywhere. It’s the big stadiums, it’s the World Cup, but it’s also the smaller stadiums, it’s the proximity,” he said. The FIFA president also expressed appreciation for the reception he received in Nigeria, assuring the country of the world football governing body’s continued support. “I feel so much the love of Africa, the love of Nigeria. I am very happy to be here. You can always count on FIFA. We are not just your partners; we are your family members,” he added. Infantino’s visit also coincided with Nigeria’s endorsement of his bid for another term as FIFA

item.title: Odukoya drags sister, others to court over removal as senior pastor
item.description: The Senior Pastor of the Fountain of Life Church, Pastor Jimmy Odukoya, has dragged his sister and others before a Federal High Court in Lagos, challenging his purported removal from office and the decisions taken by some members of the church’s Board of Trustees. Odukoya, alongside the Incorporated Trustees of the Fountain of Life Church, instituted the action against eight defendants, including Pastor Tolu Odukoya, Mr Biodun Balogun, Mr Biodun Awosika, Pastor Rotimi Okpaise, Pastor Tobi Enuha, Pastor Gbenga Onabanjo, Pastor Fred Ohiani and Pastor Akin Osinbajo. This is coming some days after a Lagos State High Court had restrained him from parading as the senior pastor in the church. Odukoya in an affidavit in support of the applications is asking the court to determine whether meetings held by some members of the church’s Board of Trustees on January 22, February 28 and November 16, 2026, and the decisions taken at those meetings complied with the church’s constitution. Odukoya said he was appointed Senior Pastor and Chairman of the Board of Trustees at an emergency meeting of the board on September 14, 2023, and was subsequently installed in September of the same year. He said the church and its organs were governed by its constitution, amended by a special resolution dated January 16, 2003, and that the defendants were members of its Board of Trustees. According to his affidavit, the disagreement began after a December 19, 2025, meeting of the board, attended by Bishop Mike Okonkwo, at which the possibility of handing over the church’s administrative arm to the Associate Senior Pastor was discussed. He said no resolution or final decision was reached at the meeting. Board meeting Odukoya said he subsequently convened a board meeting for January 5, 2026, but it could not hold because there was no quorum. He added that some trustees later presented proposals to him, many of which he declined because, according to him, they were inconsistent with the church’s constitution. He said the trustees subsequently sent him a letter dated January 7, 2026, requesting a response within three days, but he did not see it until after the deadline had elapsed. Odukoya said he later directed the board secretary to schedule a meeting for January 30, 2026, after a request for a special meeting was made by a board member. However, he alleged that a separate notice for a meeting on January 22 was circulated by the fourth defendant and did not come from the board secretariat. “I received the notice late in the evening of January 20, 2026, effectively giving me one day notice of the purported meeting,” he stated. He said he declined to attend the meeting, but the defendants proceeded with it under the name of “concerned members of the Board”. item.title: Arsenal held by Newcastle rally and lose Raya to injury
item.description: Arsenal missed the chance to open up an eight-point lead at the top of the Premier League after a stirring second-half fightback from Newcastle held the defending champions to a 2-2 draw on Saturday. The Gunners led through Eberechi Eze’s strike after a dominant first 45 minutes. But Mikel Arteta’s men were suddenly headed for defeat when goals from Harvey Barnes and Malick Thiaw provided a much-needed boost for under-fire Newcastle boss Matthias Jaissle. Noni Madueke salvaged a point for Arsenal and stretched their lead at the top over surprise package Brighton to six points. However, the loss of influential goalkeeper David Raya to injury could provide a twist in the title race that many believed Arsenal would cruise. Newcastle remain in the bottom half of the table with just one win in six games in all competitions. Yet, Jaissle can point to his side’s second half performance as a potential turning point after a difficult start to his reign at St. James’ Park. Arsenal move back six points clear of third-placed Manchester City, but missed the chance to put their foot down in the defence of their title. Madueke continued his impressive form in the injury absence of Bukayo Saka and hit the post early on. Former Newcastle captain Bruno Guimaraes was roundly booed on his first return to Tyneside since making a £75 million ($98 million) move to the Emirates Stadium In August. The Brazilian nearly silenced his former faithful when he prodded just wide from a Madueke cross as Arsenal pressed for the opener. It duly arrived 10 minutes before the break when Kai Havertz pounced on a poor touch by Lewis Hall and brilliantly played in Eze to blast high past Lukas Hornicek. Jaissle got the response he needed from his half-time team talk as Newcastle came out a completely different proposition after the break. Arsenal also played a part in letting the home side back into the game and lifting the 50,000 crowd in doing so. Martin Odegaard shanked his attempt at a long ball forward to allow William Osula to play in Barnes to level. Suddenly an Arsenal side that had kept seven clean sheets in their opening 10 league games was on the rocks. Thiaw bundled home a second for Newcastle just 13 minutes later after Dan Burn was left completely unmarked from a corner and his header was only parried by Raya. That proved to be one of Raya’s final interventions as the Spaniard had to be replaced by Kepa Arrizabalaga. Raya would be a massive miss if the Spaniard is sidelined for a significant spell. But Arsenal regained their composure in time to salvage a point that keeps them well in the driving seat to retain the title. Odegaard made amends for his earlier error by freeing Madueke down the right and he cut inside before his tame deflected shot found a way past Hornicek. item.title: Death Toll In Bayelsa Boat Accident Rises To 23
item.description: The death toll from Friday’s boat accident in Southern Ijaw Local Government Area of Bayelsa State has risen to 23, with 24 survivors receiving treatment in hospitals. The accident occurred when a boat conveying mourners to a burial ceremony capsized near Oweikorogha Community in the Ukubie area of Southern Ijaw. The Bayelsa State Police Command confirmed the incident in a statement, saying the boat was travelling from Ayama Community to Ukubie for a burial ceremony on Friday, when it capsized at about 11 a.m. A preliminary police report indicated that the boat developed a mechanical fault while navigating the waterways. Following the incident, rescue operations were launched, with several passengers rescued while others were initially reported missing. A survivor had also alleged that the wooden passenger boat, popularly known as a ‘love boat’, was overloaded with passengers and their belongings, suggesting that this might have contributed to the accident. President Bola Tinubu has expressed condolences to the families of the victims, describing the incident as tragic and directing relevant federal disaster response agencies to support rescue and recovery efforts. In a statement posted on his X account, Tinubu said, “Those who lost their lives in the tragedy did not deserve to die that way. I have directed all relevant Federal Disaster Response agencies to work together to ensure a successful recovery and rescue operation.” The President also directed that the presidential campaign rally in Ibadan, Oyo State, on Saturday, be held without much fanfare in honour of those who lost their lives. “On behalf of the entire nation, I mourn those who lost their lives in the incident and sympathise with their families, the government and the people of Bayelsa State. “I particularly mourn with Governor Douye Diri over this sad incident. I pray that God Almighty repose their souls and comfort their families,” he said. Meanwhile, Governor Douye Diri has visited the scene of the accident and is expected to initiate a probe into the circumstances surrounding the tragedy. The state government has also warned boat operators against overloading, reckless navigation and travelling without life jackets, stressing the need for strict compliance with waterway safety regulations. It also emphasised the importance of enforcing safety measures to prevent a recurrence of such incidents. ﻿ The post Death Toll In Bayelsa Boat Accident Rises To 23 appeared first on Channels Television .
